test_title: SSC GD Constable Previous Year Paper (Held on: 15th December 2021 Shift 1)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is a water-borne disease?
solution:
The correct answer is __**Cholera**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• Cholera is a** water-borne disease.**
 
• Waterborne diseases are caused by a variety of microorganisms, biotoxins, and toxic contaminants.
 
• It leads to devastating diseases such as-
 
 
• **Cholera**
 
• **Schistosomiasis**
 
• **Gastrointestinal problems**
 
 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Other Waterborne diseases
 
 
• Anaemia
 
• Arsenicosis
 
• Ascariasis
 
• Campylobacteriosis
 
• Cyanobacterial toxins
 
• Dengue and Dengue Haemorrhagic fever
 
• Diarrhoea
